Recently gave this a try as I'm not shelling out the cash for Monster Hunter World with the way Capcom handled the roll-out (Maybe during the Christmas sale if I can get it for $20-$30). Though it would be a fun game to try out the gameplay style of these games. I enjoyed the game at the start but found it quickly gets grindy. I have never played any of the other Monster Hunter games so this was my first experience of this style of game.

To take out a monster you need to upgrade your gear, to upgrade your gear you need to kill the same monster over and over. Add in that the elemental types are a good bad neutral system, but there isn't much use for the neutral elements as they are only good for the next tier up and even then you are better off with the best from the current tier even if it is bad as each step ups the starting point further and further.

The other issue is that the monsters themselves are repeats at the start but with maybe a new attack added so you are doing the fights on loop for gear and then when you do advance you get the same bloody loop again.

I mostly ignored the pay store as I knew I wasn't going to spend money with them so can't comment on what was there.

Graphics are nice but nothing elaborate, it ran smoothly for me.

Controls via keyboard and mouse work well, initially it is odd having space as a dodge and something else as jump but after playing for a bit you find that dodge is far more important so it works well.

Overall I enjoyed myself for a week with the game but didn't feel the least bit bad when I uninstalled it after that. If you like the kill a big thing solo starting out then with groups later and don't mend repetition go for it it is worth the install time being free to play, if you hate grind don't bother.
